name: Smart Lighting Control for Hue + Govee
description:
Control Philips Hue and Govee lighting from CORSAIR XENEON Edge without setting up Home Assistant.

Smart Lighting Control for Hue + Govee gives you touch-first power, brightness, color and color-temperature controls, plus favorites, Hue rooms/zones, and scenes where the connected lighting API supports them. Current state stays visible so the panel behaves like a real controller instead of a set of blind shortcuts.

Philips Hue uses your Hue Bridge locally. Pair once by pressing the physical bridge button; the generated application credential stays on your PC. Govee is local-first for compatible devices with LAN Control enabled. You may optionally add your own Govee Developer API key in the local companion to expose cloud-only device capabilities and Govee scenes.

The required PackRat Lighting Companion runs only on your Windows PC, binds to localhost, and keeps Philips Hue and Govee credentials out of the XENEON widget. There is no PackRat cloud, no PackRat account, and PackRat does not collect your lighting credentials.

Hue-only and Govee-only setups are fully supported. Controls are capability-aware, so unsupported features are hidden rather than faked.

This is an independent third-party PackRat product. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Signify, Philips Hue, or Govee. Philips Hue and Govee are trademarks of their respective owners.

Part of the PackRat Ecosystem.
release_notes: Direct Philips Hue Bridge pairing and local light, room/zone, scene, brightness, color and color-temperature control.
Local-first Govee LAN discovery/control with optional Govee Developer API support for cloud-only capabilities and scenes.
Favorites, one-touch scenes, live capability-aware state, and touch-first color/brightness controls.
Eight tuned XENEON Edge layouts plus a localhost-only PackRat Lighting Companion with no PackRat cloud.
